# Eidentic Playground

> A live, in-browser demo of [Eidentic](https://eidentic.dev) — the open-source TypeScript SDK
> for building AI agents with self-improving, cross-session memory. Chat with an agent that
> remembers you across turns, watch its temporal knowledge graph fill in as you talk, inspect the
> memory blocks it writes, and erase everything in a single call. Bring your own OpenAI or
> Anthropic API key; it stays in your browser and is never stored or logged server-side.

## What this demonstrates

- **Cross-session memory**: the agent recalls facts you told it in earlier turns without re-sending the whole history.
- **Temporal knowledge graph**: facts are extracted as `(subject, predicate, object)` triples with validity over time, shown live in the right-hand inspector.
- **Memory blocks**: durable, editable summaries the agent maintains about you.
- **Right to erasure (GDPR)**: one call to `eraseScope()` fans out and deletes everything for a session.
- **Bring-your-own-key**: the key lives in browser localStorage and is sent only with your own requests.
